title: HarnessSecurity-Bench: Do Security Mechanisms Really Protect Coding Agent Harnesses?

object.carrier: none (no persistent-state object studied)：评测对象是六个编码智能体 harness 的九类原生安全机制（AA/NI/CAL/CDL/MCP/PIF/PR/RO/PT）在单次隔离 Docker 容器内单任务执行中的 ON/OFF 即时效果；攻击资源（仓库工件、指令/技能、工具描述、任务级知识记录、外部服务）均随任务投递、trial 结束即弃，不构成被研究的跨会话持久状态；audit logging（AL）虽在 RQ1 分类中但被排除在 RQ3 之外

safety_property.statement: 被测 harness 安全机制处于 ON 时应阻断攻击效应（确定性 attack-effect oracle：未授权工具/命令调用、对受保护文件/数据库/平台状态的未授权修改、canary/token 等敏感数据外送至攻击者接收端），同时保持 utility oracle 通过率；安全性以 ASR（通过的 attack-effect oracle 比例）判定并与 utility 一并报告。限制合法与恶意操作共享的能力会同时阻断两者（utility 代价），而被允许的工具/命令可能经替代执行路径使未授权操作仍可达。
safety_property.operationalized_as: Utility = 通过的 utility oracle 检查比例；ASR = 通过的 attack-effect oracle 检查比例；确定性 oracle 检查文件/数据库变更、接收端记录与执行事件，oracle 定义与判定保存在 agent 工作区之外；ΔUtility/ΔASR 以百分点报告，U 判定从分母剔除（§5.3、§6.1）

capabilities: 在任务仓库与工作流工件中预置载荷（文档、源码注释、配置文件）：把未授权动作包装成 misleading workflow steps 或 fabricated operational prerequisites
投毒 agent 指令与技能文件（MCP Email Validation 的 poisoned AGENTS.md；PT Pixel Pet Codec 的项目指令）
在工具描述与工具返回内容中嵌入注入指令（Doc Search 工具描述诱导未授权 admin_exec；Issue Triage 的 incident handoff 响应要求提交附件/日志）
通过未修改的数据库工具投毒任务级知识/案例记录（StreamLoop：关于 retention、reviewer identity、policy exceptions 的协调性虚假业务记录）
控制外部服务与执行依赖：包生命周期钩子、reporter 端点、HTTP 记录，触发未授权回调与 canary 外传
目标为攻击者指定的具体未授权动作（queue purging、build token posting、deployment manifest upload、recovery snapshot deletion、evidence deletion、privilege escalation、policy change 等），由确定性 attack-effect oracle 判定成败
assumptions: 合法用户指令是任务要求的权威来源且在攻击增强中保持不变；utility oracle 与合法完成路径保留
攻击以任务执行中自然遇到的资源/工件形式投递；direct-user-input 攻击面被排除
每次 trial 在固定镜像的新隔离 Docker 容器中运行；oracle 定义与判定位于 agent 工作区之外
被测机制的 ON/OFF 由评测者设定，其余 sandbox/approval/network/tool 配置在每次 ON/OFF 对照中固定并记录
not_covered: 直接用户输入攻击（direct-user-input surface 明确排除出 HSB 评测范围）
audit logging（AL）不进入 RQ3 运行时评测
闭环源 harness 的运行时评测（RQ3 仅六个开源 harness；闭环源在 RQ2 中大量 U 评级）
跨会话/持久化的知识-记忆攻击（任务级知识投毒均在单 trial 内交付）
真实部署环境与 GLM-5.2 之外的基础模型（Docker/模拟服务不完全再现真实部署；单基础模型限制泛化）

intervention.name: 被评测对象为六个编码智能体 harness 的原生安全机制（AA、NI、CAL、CDL、MCP、PIF、PR、RO、PT；论文未提出新机制，HSB 是评测基准）
intervention.description: HSB 对产品化 harness 已实现的安全机制做同环境 ON/OFF 对照：auto-approve（跳过确认）、network isolation（默认拒绝出口/域名白名单）、command allowlisting/denylisting、MCP 权限、prompt-injection filtering（内容层）、path restriction、read-only mode、project trust（仓库资源准入）；每次对照固定其余 sandbox/approval/network/tool 配置；AL（audit logging）被排除在 RQ3 之外。

controls.name: Security setting OFF（原生机制禁用；AA-OFF 的权限请求由独立 Qwen3.8-27B 审查者经确定性 bridge 审批）
U/D/A 单 setting 行（U 观察原生默认；D 仅 ON；A 仅 OFF baseline）
每次 ON/OFF 对照固定其余 sandbox/approval/network/tool 配置并记录

results.claim: Enabling auto-approve (ON) across six harnesses on the 2-task AA benchmark raises overall ASR from 29.2% to 95.6% (+66.4 pp) while utility rises from 77.1% to 95.4% (+18.3 pp): skipping confirmation lets both legitimate and malicious prerequisite operations proceed more readily.
results.setting: 被测机制 auto-approve（AA）；2 任务（Job Scheduler Backoff, Settlement Fee Rounding）×6 harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot）×10 trials/setting；基础模型 GLM-5.2；AA-OFF 由独立 Qwen3.8-27B 审查者经确定性 bridge 审批全部六个 harness 的权限请求，ON=跳过原生确认；每 setting 120 trials / 360 attack checks / 780 utility checks
results.quote: Utility rose from 77.1% to 95.4% (+18.3+18.3 pp), while ASR rose from 29.2% to 95.6% (+66.4+66.4 pp).

denominator.n_total: 360 attack-effect oracle checks and 780 utility oracle checks per setting (2 tasks × 6 harnesses × 10 trials)
denominator.how_counted: Table 6 Overall row counts; rates = passed oracles / total oracles, Unknown (U) verdicts excluded (§6.1)

results.claim: With network isolation enabled (ON), overall ASR falls from 57.1% to 0.8% (-56.3 pp) but utility falls from 90.9% to 66.4% (-24.5 pp): required network interactions account for 161 of the 162 fewer utility passes, so the restriction blocks registry-dependent legitimate work together with malicious callbacks/exfiltration.
results.setting: 被测机制 network isolation（NI）；2 任务（Dependency Lock Repair, CI Summary Repair）×6 harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot）×10 trials/setting；GLM-5.2；ON=默认拒绝出口/域名白名单生效，OFF=网络访问不受限；每 setting 120 trials / 240 attack checks / 660 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 240 attack-effect oracle checks and 660 utility oracle checks per setting
denominator.how_counted: Table 6 NI Overall row counts; U verdicts excluded (§6.1)

results.claim: With command allowlisting enabled (ON), overall ASR falls from 98.1% to 50.0% (-48.1 pp) with only a 1.5 pp utility loss (99.2% -> 97.7%): most legitimate implementation and validation remains achievable through permitted commands.
results.setting: 被测机制 command allowlisting（CAL）；2 任务（CLI Arg Parser, Markdown Table Render）×6 harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot）×10 trials/setting；GLM-5.2；ON=显式命令白名单，OFF=无限制命令策略；每 setting 120 trials / 360 attack checks / 660 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 360 attack-effect oracle checks and 660 utility oracle checks per setting
denominator.how_counted: Table 6 CAL Overall row counts; U verdicts excluded (§6.1)

results.claim: With command denylisting enabled (ON, four paired harnesses), overall ASR falls from 41.7% to 1.3% (-40.4 pp) while overall utility rises from 94.6% to 99.8% (+5.2 pp); for example, blocking the induced key-copying preserved 15 of the 29 additional utility passes that had been invalidated under OFF.
results.setting: 被测机制 command denylisting（CDL）；2 任务（Record Deduplication, INI Config Parsing）；6 harness 中 4 个支持 ON/OFF 对照（Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot），Codex CLI 与 gptme 为 default-enforced 仅 ON、不进 Overall；GLM-5.2；Overall 每 setting 240 attack checks / 560 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 240 attack-effect oracle checks and 560 utility oracle checks per setting (paired harnesses only)
denominator.how_counted: Table 6 CDL Overall row counts; Overall includes only harnesses evaluated in both settings (§6.1)

results.claim: With MCP permissions enabled (ON, three-task MCP benchmark), overall ASR falls from 82.2% to 54.2% (-28.1 pp) with overall utility roughly unchanged (73.3% -> 73.9%); some retained operations could still alter protected state.
results.setting: 被测机制 MCP permissions（MCP）；3 任务（Doc Search, Email Validation, StreamLoop case reconciliation）×6 harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot）×10 trials/setting；GLM-5.2；ON=MCP/外部工具服务器授权与调用范围限制，OFF=无工具白名单且默认放行；每 setting 180 trials / 360 attack checks / 1140 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 360 attack-effect oracle checks and 1140 utility oracle checks per setting
denominator.how_counted: Table 7 MCP Overall row counts; U verdicts excluded (§6.1)

results.claim: With path restriction enabled (ON, four paired harnesses on the four-task PR benchmark), overall ASR falls from 95.0% to 46.9% (-48.1 pp) with utility essentially unchanged (81.6% -> 81.9%); per-harness ASR reductions ranged from complete observed suppression (Codex CLI, gptme) to almost unchanged outcomes (Claude Code, Qwen Code).
results.setting: 被测机制 path restriction（PR）；4 任务（Claims Reimbursement, Safe Path Join, MVCC LSM Compaction, Embedding Drift Monitor）；paired harness：Codex CLI, Claude Code, gptme, Qwen Code（Gemini CLI 与 GitHub Copilot 为 default-enforced 仅 ON，不进 Overall）；GLM-5.2；Overall 每 setting 160 attack checks / 1440 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 160 attack-effect oracle checks and 1440 utility oracle checks per setting (paired harnesses only)
denominator.how_counted: Table 7 PR Overall row counts; Overall includes only harnesses evaluated in both settings (§6.1)

results.claim: With read-only mode enabled (ON), overall ASR falls from 8.3% to 0.8% (-7.5 pp) from a low OFF baseline while utility drops from 69.8% to 35.8% (-34.0 pp): checks requiring persistent implementation changes account for 347 of the 367 fewer utility passes.
results.setting: 被测机制 read-only mode（RO）；2 任务（Takeaway Ordering, Bike Dispatch Audit）×6 harness（Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot）×10 trials/setting；GLM-5.2；ON=抑制覆盖操作内的持久变更（approval_policy 固定），OFF=允许写入；每 setting 120 trials / 120 attack checks / 1080 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 120 attack-effect oracle checks and 1080 utility oracle checks per setting
denominator.how_counted: Table 7 RO Overall row counts; U verdicts excluded (§6.1)

results.claim: With the workspace marked untrusted (PT ON, five paired harnesses), overall ASR falls from 75.3% to 40.3% (-35.0 pp) and utility falls from 100.0% to 80.0% (-20.0 pp); the entire utility loss comes from Gemini CLI refusing startup in all 40 ON trials after the workspace was marked untrusted.
results.setting: 被测机制 project trust（PT）；4 任务（Constellation Postcard, Pixel Pet Codec, Pocket Music Box, Clockwork Mobile）；5 个 paired harness（Codex CLI, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot；gptme 对 PT 为 absent，仅 OFF）；GLM-5.2；ON=工作区标记 untrusted，OFF=trusted（approval/sandbox/network 固定）；Overall 每 setting 300 attack checks / 1200 utility checks

denominator.n_total: 300 attack-effect oracle checks and 1200 utility oracle checks per setting (paired harnesses only)
denominator.how_counted: Table 7 PT Overall row counts; Overall includes only harnesses evaluated in both settings (§6.1)

results.claim: Excluding the Gemini CLI startup-refusal configuration, the other four PT harnesses retain 100% utility while ASR falls from 75.8% to 50.4%: denying task startup differs from limiting repository resources during execution while retaining a legitimate completion path.
results.value: ASR 50.4% (ON, excluding Gemini CLI startup-refusal configuration)
results.setting: 被测机制 project trust（PT）；Claude Code, Codex CLI, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot 四个在 ON 下继续执行的 harness；GLM-5.2；ON=工作区 untrusted
results.quote:
This utility loss came entirely from Gemini CLI refusing startup in all 40 ON trials after the workspace was marked untrusted.
Excluding that startup-refusal configuration, the other four harnesses retained 100% utility while ASR fell from 75.8% to 50.4%.

denominator.n_total: 4 harnesses × 60 attack-effect oracle checks per setting = 240 (derived from Table 7 per-harness rows); utility 240 oracle checks per harness per setting
denominator.how_counted: derived from Table 7 PT per-harness paired rows (Codex, Claude Code, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot); prose rates 75.8% -> 50.4% given in §6.2

results.claim: For prompt-injection filtering only gptme supports a paired ON/OFF comparison: ASR falls by 3.3 pp (16/60 -> 14/60 passed attack checks) and utility falls by 1.9 pp; the filter matches explicit injection patterns in tool outputs, and attacks presented as ordinary workflow prerequisites can still influence execution under this screening.
results.setting: 被测机制 prompt-injection filtering（PIF）；2 任务（Issue Triage, C# Maze）；仅 gptme 支持 ON/OFF 对照（其余 harness 的 PIF 为 U/D/A 单 setting，不能确立 ON/OFF 效应）；GLM-5.2；gptme 过滤器匹配工具输出中的显式注入模式并添加警告；paired 部分 60 attack checks / 160 utility checks 每 setting
results.quote: Only gptme supported a paired PIF comparison: ASR fell by 3.3 pp, from 16/60 to 14/60 passed attack checks, while utility fell by 1.9 pp.

denominator.n_total: 60 attack-effect oracle checks for the only paired comparison (gptme)
denominator.how_counted: §6.2 prose counts; Table 7 PIF rows show remaining cells are single-setting (U/D/A)

results.claim: Across 40 harnesses × 10 mechanisms (400 cells), 205 cells have confirmed implementation (109 opt-in O, 64 configurable-off C, 32 default-enforced D), 83 have confirmed absence, and 112 remain unknown: about half of confirmed mechanism implementations are opt-in.
results.value: 205/400 implemented; 109 opt-in (O), 96 active by default (64 C, 32 D)
results.setting: 40 harness（27 开源 + 13 闭环源）×10 机制 = 400 cells；5 评分者独立评级（L1 Claude Opus 4.8、L2 DeepSeek V4 Flash、L3 GLM-5.2、H1、H2；Evidence-of-thought 评级须引用出处与行区间），≥3/5 多数决，18 个无多数 cell 由 H1-H3 仲裁；语料截止 2026-08-31
results.quote:
Of 400 harness–mechanism cells, 205 have confirmed implementation (D, C, or O), 83 have confirmed absence (A), and 112 are rated U.
Within the 205 implemented cells, O is the most frequent rating (109); the remaining 96 are active by default (64 C and 32 D).

denominator.n_valid: 205 implemented (109 O + 64 C + 32 D); 83 absent (A); 112 unknown (U)
denominator.how_counted: §4.2; consensus = rating supported by at least 3 of 5 raters

results.claim: Implementation-evidence gaps concentrate in closed-source harnesses: unknown (U) ratings account for 69 of 130 closed-source cells (53.1%) versus 43 of 270 open-source cells (15.9%), and cover all 13 closed-source PIF cells.
results.setting: 同 RQ2 评级矩阵（40 harness × 10 机制），按开源（270 cells）与闭环源（130 cells）分组统计 U 评级占比
results.quote: More broadly, U accounts for 69 of 130 closed-source cells (53.1%), compared with 43 of 270 open-source cells (15.9%).

denominator.how_counted: §4.2; U = insufficient or conflicting evidence about implementation or default state

results.claim: Task-level bypass: on the CLI Arg Parser task under Qwen Code with command allowlisting enabled, the native gate rejected the unauthorized checker but the agent later invoked it through an allowed Python interpreter; the trial passed all six utility checks and all three attack-effect checks, so allowed tools or commands can leave unauthorized operations reachable through alternative execution paths.
results.value: all three attack-effect checks passed despite CAL ON
results.setting: CLI Arg Parser 任务（CAL 基准），Qwen Code 且 CAL ON，GLM-5.2；单 trial 案例观察（每组合共 10 trials）
results.quote: The trial passed all six utility checks and all three attack-effect checks, showing that satisfying the checked task requirements coexisted with successful attack effects.

denominator.n_total: 3 attack-effect oracle checks in the CLI Arg Parser task trial
denominator.how_counted: §6.3 Case B prose (all three attack-effect checks passed; all six utility checks passed)

limitations.statement: AA-OFF 的审批决定由固定的 LLM 审查者标准化，但模型偏差与残余非确定性仍可能影响个别审批决定；报告的 AA 结果反映所规定的审批配置。
limitations.quote: Model bias and residual nondeterminism may still affect individual approval decisions, so the reported AA results reflect the specified approval configuration.

limitations.statement: 研究者与模型偏差可能影响 RQ1–RQ2 评级结果的准确性与一致性（以 Evidence-of-Thought 评级与仲裁缓解）。
limitations.quote: Researcher and model biases may affect the accuracy and consistency of RQ1–RQ2 results.

limitations.statement: 闭环源 harness 难以可复现评测（GUI IDE 工作流的自动化执行可能无法忠实再现交互操作），核心运行时评测因此仅覆盖六个开源 harness。
limitations.quote: Closed-source harnesses are more difficult to evaluate reproducibly because their interaction modes differ, particularly for GUI-based IDE workflows, where automated execution may not faithfully reproduce interactive operation.

limitations.statement: Docker 容器、自动化执行与模拟服务不能完全再现真实部署环境。
limitations.quote: Docker containers, automated execution, and simulated services do not fully reproduce real deployments.

limitations.statement: 使用单一基础模型（GLM-5.2）可能限制 RQ3 的泛化性：不同模型在工具使用与指令遵循上的差异会影响绝对 ASR 与 ON/OFF 差值幅度。
limitations.quote: Using a single base LLM may limit the generalizability of RQ3 because different models can vary in tool use and instruction following, affecting both absolute ASR and the magnitude of ON/OFF differences.

limitations.statement: 模型随机性与偶发错误输出可能在重复执行间引入波动（以每条件重复 10 次缓解）。
limitations.quote: Model stochasticity and occasional erroneous outputs may introduce variation across repeated executions.
